svg.text: LH-1 electrical harness, revision L (generated from wiring.csv)
277 cables, 157 devices. 24 V SELV behind two enclosed supplies. NOT safety-assessed. Lines: cable_id; dashed red = safety chain; loops = cables inside one location.

svg.text: Safety chain (hardware, no software in the path)
ESTOP (2 NC, ch1 S11-S12, ch2 S21-S22: W-S-03/04) -> SR1 (manual reset RESET_PB, feedback KM1+KM2 NC) -> KM1 + KM2 in series
KM1+KM2 main poles: MOTION trunk (F2 16 A -> F21 gantry, F22 head, F23 TC-1 lid), PIPETTE (F3), THERM_AUX (F4)
KM1+KM2 aux NO -> SAFE_E -> TC_TS_BLOCK 110 C -> TC_TS_SINK 75 C -> TC_TS_LID 130 C -> TC_RELAY coil -> THERM (F5 25 A, PSU_TC)
SAFE_E also -> TCB1 J_SAFE (hardware disable of H-bridge and lid heater: requested)
DOOR_SW (coded magnetic, 2 channels: W-S-16/17) -> SR2 (auto reset, feedback KM3+KM4 NC) -> KM3 + KM4 in series on MOTION only
THERM_AUX: TBC TEC+ -> TB_TCO 72 C cut-off -> TB_KSD 70 C -> Peltier (in the TEC lead)
Stays up after e-stop and door: LOGIC (F1): host, Octopus logic, TCB1 logic, all fans; e-stop/door aux contacts -> PG11 / PB7 (logging only)
Consequence: Klipper shuts down on every e-stop and door opening (TMC under-voltage; MMB head MCUs are on MOTION): FIRMWARE_RESTART + re-home
